run_grpo_vlm_training: run GRPO VLM training with a CARLA autonomous driving environment using HuggingFace TRL
create_carla_grpo_env: create a CarlaGRPOEnv instance that wraps a CARLA server for vision-language model tool use
build_multimodal_observation: build a multimodal observation from a CARLA scene with camera image and text description
run_carla_tools: run CARLA driving tools like observe, emergency_stop, and lane_change within a GRPO training loop
configure_grpo_trainer: configure a GRPOTrainer with CARLA environment, reward function, and tracking for VLM fine-tuning
